claims.text: Residents in Nepal returned to flood-ravaged homes to salvage belongings from mud and debris.
Rescuers used explosives to blast into the hillside and pumped air into the Trishuli-3A site to reach trapped workers on Monday.
Nepal's disaster management authority reported the death toll from the flood disaster on the Nepal-Tibet border reached 939.
Nepal's disaster management authority estimated 3,925 people are missing, including 592 foreign nationals.
Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah announced that 279 people had been rescued from hydropower plant sites.
Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah stated that a total of 11,379 people have been rescued so far across the country.
An international rescue team comprising Chinese and Nepalese military personnel alongside experts from India, Korea, and Australia is searching for trapped workers.
In Chitwan district, river systems brought nearly 300 dead bodies to the banks, prompting makeshift temporary burials.
Chinese state media reported an official death toll of 16 in Tibet, with 546 people reported missing.
Chinese authorities imposed administrative penalties on individuals speculating online that casualty numbers in Tibet are higher than reported.
Eight workers from Assam who were stranded at the Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project returned home late Sunday.
Eight workers from Assam who worked at the Upper Trishuli-1 project remain missing following the August 26 flash floods.
Nepalese military helicopters spotted stranded workers on a hilltop after two days and provided water and biscuits before airlifting them to Kathmandu.
A study by Nepalese scientists found the August 26 flood was triggered by an ice-rock avalanche that travelled 22 kilometres to Rasuwagadhi in just over seven minutes at an average speed of 167 kmph.
The study by the Nepal Environment Society found the avalanche originated in the Langtang-Lirung area of Rasuwa at an altitude of approximately 5,200 metres around 8:37 am.
Nepalese researchers found no evidence of a glacial lake outburst flood or exceptionally heavy rainfall causing the disaster.
Preliminary Nepal Electricity Authority data showed 13 hydropower projects and one solar project were affected, knocking 431 MW of generation capacity offline.
US President Donald Trump stated 'We're going to hit them hard' following renewed military exchanges with Iran.
The United States carried out strikes on Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island on Sunday to prevent Iran from placing mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iranian state media reported three people were killed and several wounded in the US strike on Larak Island.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards launched ballistic missiles at two US bases in Jordan, claiming to inflict heavy damage.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian called for dialogue at a summit in Kyrgyzstan, stating that continuing the war is neither in Iran's nor the region's interest.
Donald Trump posted on Truth Social calling Iran a 'Failed Nation' and claiming 'IT IS DEAD!'.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi demanded on Iranian state television that the US return to its previous commitments.
US Vice President JD Vance said Donald Trump's social media post about Kharg Island was intended as a signal to Iran.
A US official stated the American military did not strike Kharg Island during overnight operations.
The United Arab Emirates foreign ministry condemned an Iranian drone attack intercepted over its territorial waters as a dangerous escalation.
US Central Command denied claims by Iranian state TV that a supertanker struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Kharg Island handled about 90 percent of Iran's oil exports before the conflict began on February 28.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated two people were killed and two injured in the US strikes on Larak Island.
Iran demands commercial tankers passing Larak Island undergo checks and reportedly charges $2 million per crossing.
The United States and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes against Iran on February 28, 2026.
Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international soccer on Monday, August 31, 2026.
Forbes estimates Lionel Messi's total net worth to be approximately $1.1 billion in 2026.
Inter Miami owner Jorge Mas valued Lionel Messi's yearly package with the club between $70 million and $80 million.
Lionel Messi retired from international football at age 39 after 21 years of national-team duty.
Lionel Messi made 207 appearances for Argentina and finished as the country's all-time top scorer with 125 goals, including 21 in World Cups.
Lionel Messi revealed he drafted his retirement letter on July 21, two days after Argentina lost the 2026 World Cup final to Spain, but delayed publishing it due to his father's declining health.
Lionel Messi won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar alongside Copa America titles in 2021 and 2024.
In 2012, Lionel Messi set a calendar-year record by scoring 91 goals across club and international competitions.
Lionel Messi won a record eighth Ballon d'Or in 2023 following his World Cup triumph in Qatar.
Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin met on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.
The SCO summit in Bishkek marks the 25th anniversary of the regional security and economic bloc.
Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated that Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin primarily discussed economic relations and touched on the Ukraine conflict only in passing.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with Vladimir Putin in Bishkek and expressed India's willingness to assist in resolving the Ukraine conflict.
Chinese President Xi Jinping stated China is ready to work with Russia to advance an equal and orderly multipolar world.
Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed expanding cooperation with China in artificial intelligence and digital innovation.
Vladimir Putin offered to establish a permanent visa-free regime with China if Beijing considers it beneficial.
Vladimir Putin noted that bilateral visa-free travel boosted tourist flows between Russia and China by 43 percent in the first half of the year.
